title: Independent Richards Head-Budget Scale Characterization from Disjoint Temporal Evidence
scientific_interpretation: The independent evidence establishes the numerical scale of the qualified Richards temporal indicator over the frozen matrices, but not an application accuracy requirement. The observed relationship to the available finite-reference discrepancy varies by more than an order of magnitude and is state- and horizon-dependent. Selecting H_budget from these observations alone would therefore turn characterization into an unsupported target-independent-but-application-unanchored policy choice.

downstream_boundary.missing_dependency: A finite positive numeric H_budget with admissible independent application/runtime provenance, or a separately qualified versioned numerical policy template anchored to an explicit accuracy objective rather than indicator magnitude alone.

next_action: Do not tune or infer H_budget from F-GC02 or from the observed B_inf distribution. Either obtain an explicit external/application accuracy requirement, or open a separate pre-registered policy-template research unit whose accuracy objective and validation evidence are independent of F-GC02 and whose failure cannot be repaired post hoc by changing the numeric value.
